cases.subject: valid current envelope opens automatically with explanation
cases.given: startup probe finds a valid current envelope with no conflict and no export disagreement
cases.expected: the chart opens with the visible explanation and Discard/New actions; audio is never initialized by recovery

cases.subject: stale or export-disagreeing envelope offers Keep/Discard
cases.given: a valid current envelope stale against the stored export binding
cases.expected: the Keep/Discard alertdialog offer renders with the frozen vocabulary and the recovered-at time

cases.subject: corrupt current offers the previous copy
cases.given: a corrupt current envelope with a valid previous envelope
cases.expected: the fallback offer renders: the current copy is unreadable, Keep previous / Discard are offered

cases.subject: unrecoverable reports one nonblocking diagnostic
cases.given: neither envelope decodes
cases.expected: one nonblocking notice: recovery data could not be read, editing and export work, export recommended; the blank workspace stands

cases.subject: no envelopes renders nothing
cases.given: startup probe finds no envelopes
cases.expected: none-available: no dialog, no notice, blank workspace

cases.subject: editing before probe settlement downgrades auto-open
cases.given: the user edited the blank document before the recovery probe settled
cases.expected: automatic opening downgrades to the Keep/Discard offer; the in-memory document is never silently overwritten

cases.subject: confirmed replacement rides stop-and-swap while playing
cases.given: a dirty chart mid-playback; New confirmed
cases.expected: one workflow begin: transport retires with receipts awaited, then the document publishes; no intermediate frame; the new document stands at ready

cases.subject: replacement while paused is atomic
cases.given: a dirty chart paused mid-run; lesson load confirmed
cases.expected: the same serialized retirement-then-publish chain; the paused run cannot attack after the swap

cases.subject: replacement while previewing is atomic
cases.given: a chord preview sounding while an import commit is confirmed
cases.expected: the preview retires with the progression before publish; no preview voice survives the swap

cases.subject: precommit validation failure preserves the current chart
cases.given: an import commit whose candidate fails validation after confirmation
cases.expected: the transition settles back to idle through the workflow cancel path; the current document is byte-for-byte intact; the dialog reports the refusal code verbatim

cases.subject: audio failure during replacement preserves current state
cases.given: the transport retirement faults mid-transition
cases.expected: the document is not published; the current state remains authoritative; the dialog shows the failure with its stable code

cases.subject: busy workflow refuses a second replacement
cases.given: a replacement transition in flight and a second confirm gesture
cases.expected: import.replacement_workflow_busy; one transition exists at any time; the dialog shows busy, never two commits

cases.subject: storage unavailable renders the frozen string
cases.given: both persistence adapters unusable at startup
cases.expected: the status strip shows 'Recovery unavailable — export recommended' with an actionable path; editing, transport, and export are untouched

cases.subject: quota presents pending truthfully
cases.given: a background write answered quota
cases.expected: recovery state reports pending/failed with the code recovery.quota_exceeded and the pending wording; never a saved claim

cases.subject: write denied surfaces the code and next action
cases.given: a write answered denied
cases.expected: the storage notice names recovery.write_denied and recommends export; the notice is dismissible and the strip keeps the truthful state

cases.subject: exact export success advances the marker
cases.given: a canonical JSON export delivered and published
cases.expected: mark-exported at the export revision; the strip shows 'Exported at revision {n}'; A1 records the binding

cases.subject: cancelled or failed download advances nothing
cases.given: an export whose browser delivery is cancelled or fails
cases.expected: the marker and the A1 binding do not move; the strip still shows 'Changed since export' when that is true

cases.subject: MIDI export never advances the canonical marker
cases.given: a successful MIDI export
cases.expected: exportRevision is unchanged; the strip's export row does not move

cases.subject: no string calls recovery a save
cases.given: every startup, strip, dialog, notice, tooltip, and announcement U5 renders
cases.expected: only the five frozen vocabulary strings carry {time}/{revision}; the word Save never appears on a recovery surface

cases.subject: oversized non-undoable replacement discloses before confirm
cases.given: a replacement whose history retention would exceed the cap
cases.expected: the history-limit dialog states history is at its boundary, the replacement cannot be undone, recommends export, and requires explicit confirmation; without it the refusal history.nonundoable_confirmation_required stands
